summary: Burn CPU/WASM exported all 8 declared LoRA gradients across 8,192 values with cosine similarity 0.999999999999924 and preserved the established dense browser result.

guardrails.detail: The browser exported exactly 8 tensors and 8,192 values with the Python names and shapes.
The fresh dense CPU/WASM regression retained all 52 tensors and relative L2 2.788216012272494e-7.

findings.label: CPU/WASM adapter parity established
findings.description: The broadly available browser fallback reproduced the complete adapter-gradient contract well inside every gate.

findings.label: Adapter-only readback stayed bounded
findings.description: The browser returned 8,192 trainable values rather than the dense model's 1,334,016 gradient values.

limitations: This is a local single-browser parity run, not an accepted coordinator assignment.
The complete T0 base still resides in browser-accessible memory; no RAM or storage offload is exercised.
One browser version and host were measured, so throughput does not generalize to all community hardware.
The synthetic T0 fixture does not establish useful adaptation quality.
